item.title: Senior Service Reliability Engineer - Amadeus
item.description:
I ensure the availability and resilience of mission-critical travel technology platforms, collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple continents.

Working across Azure and Kubernetes, I maintain and improve platform reliability at enterprise scale, driving observability with Grafana, Splunk, and OpenTelemetry while supporting SLO/SLI definition and incident response workflows.

Achievements

  1. Ensured availability and resilience of mission-critical travel technology platforms at enterprise scale, working across Azure and Kubernetes with globally distributed engineering teams.
  2. Drove observability with Grafana, Splunk, and OpenTelemetry, supporting SLO/SLI definition and incident response workflows.

What is Amadeus?

Amadeus is a leading technology company powering the global travel industry with solutions for airlines, hotels, railways, and more.

item.title: DevOps Engineer - Publicis Sapient
item.description:
I worked as a DevOps Engineer designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on AWS for a large-scale legacy database migration.

Achievements

  1. Designed a multi-AZ AWS architecture for a large-scale legacy database migration, ensuring high availability and resilience with RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, KMS, Secrets Manager, Lambda, and EventBridge, compliant with HIPAA standards.
  2. Implemented the full infrastructure as code using Terraform, deploying across multiple environments via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
  3. Validated extensive IAM policies to enable secure resource provisioning across Glue, SQS, SNS, EC2, and broader AWS services.

What is Publicis Sapient?

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation consultancy helping organizations thrive in the digital economy.

item.title: Consultant - SysOps Engineer - Excelia
item.description:
As a SysOps consultant, I managed 100+ Linux servers embedded in commercial aircraft across multiple airlines, enabling proactive incident detection and ensuring real-time observability and high availability in mission-critical air-gapped environments.

Achievements

  1. Managed 100+ Linux servers embedded in commercial aircraft across multiple airlines, enabling proactive incident detection with Grafana and Kibana.
  2. Ensured real-time observability and high availability in mission-critical air-gapped environments.
  3. Automated fleet-wide operations and orchestrated containerized workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Ansible, reducing manual intervention across the board.

What is Excelia?

Excelia is a global professional services, technology, and business process outsourcing firm founded in 1999 and headquartered in Madrid, Spain, helping organizations improve operations through digital transformation, enterprise applications, and strategy consulting.

item.title: Software Engineer - OFEX
item.description:
In my role, I handle both Software Engineering and DevOps duties. My main responsibility is leading the development of cutting-edge software solutions designed to automate processes for server infrastructure and personnel operations.

Achievements

  1. I Enhanced the infrastructure with microservices based solutions, using Docker to manage multiple applications in Python, Javascript and PHP; Nginx as a reverse proxy, as a result we managed to reach more than 10000 users.
  2. I performed technical reviews of a nationally impactful software as part of a project valued at nearly $1 million dollars, aimed at making informed design decisions, identifying software flaws, and assessing potential cyber risk scenarios.
  3. I developed software using python for automating manual document analysis and management actions, increasing x10 the speed of the work team.

What is OFEX?

OFEX (“Oficina de Extensión”) is a project management entity between the District University and external organizations of the public sector.

item.title: SysOps Engineer - National Institute of Health
item.description:
This position bore similarities to that of a Site Reliability Engineer, where my responsibilities encompassed the deployment and management of both Linux and Windows servers throughout the platform migration process. This was part of deployment and migration of an e-learning platform known as evigiaula.

Achievements

  1. I deployed the platform on a Windows Server with IIS, MariaDB and PHP to support 1000+ concurrent users.
  2. I deployed the platform on a Linux server with Docker, managing MySQL, MariaDB and Apache containers for development and testing for a team of 10+ people.
  3. I contributed to the security analysis of the virtual infrastructure using NMAP and on-site physical analysis to minimize the attack surface cyber attack surface.

What is INS

INS (Instituto Nacional de Salud) is a public institution which main task is the research of the priority health problems that affect the Colombian community, in addition to carrying out development and technology transfer.

item.title: IT Support Technician - RITA

item.title: Assitant Web Developer - Argos Garments
